subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'SHORT' is written as '1' and 'THEME' is written as '2'. How will 'TRAIN’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- The code represents total number of vowels in the given word.

​So,

 
• 'SHORT' is written as '1'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb43daf9f011795d44451397f47e0dccc3c63874f09e03b6b046200a4d2127f4.png] 

And,

 
• 'THEME' is written as '2'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a5b042ae592ed282996b2959d8d6ea0ca50f07df3a69654dd176a324acbf399.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'TRAIN’ will be written

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3a76c2213b218fb41be3ab357e688b65c08a0f086638d6395410709a853739e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "2".
